[[A New Elementalist Trainer]] | map = [[File:Further Adventures Map.jpg|200px]] | map1text = The road to [[Devona]] in [[Ashford]]. | experience reward = 250 | completion reward = 25g ({{reforgedmode}} only) }} While he believes you have potential, [[Haversdan]] directs you to seek out [[Devona]] in [[Ashford]] to gain more real-world experience. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = y }} ===Objectives=== * Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Talk to Devona. ===Reward=== * 250 [[Experience]] * 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) ==Walkthrough== From [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]], follow the road going southwest. As you approach [[Ashford Abbey]], turn south and follow the quest marker to Devona. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Haversdan :''"You're the [[Sir Tydus]] was telling me about, aren't you? Well, I imagine he's right that you've got potential, but potential won't save you from a [[Charr]] [[firestorm]]. Experience will.'' :''I suggest you head southwest to Ashford and talk to '''Devona'''. She's bound to have a task or two for you."'' {{Offer dialog | accept = Thank you. I'll take your advice. | decline = I think I'll just wander around for a bit. | ask = I do recommend going to see '''Devona''' in Ashford. The way is simple enough. Just follow the road southwest until you reach the village. I'm sure you'll find Devona without much trouble. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Devona :''"I'm glad you've come. I can't seem to shake the feeling that there's trouble on the horizon, and I'd be glad to have your help if and when it arrives. In the meantime, there are plenty of people here who need assistance with one thing or another, and I'm sure you'll find the lessons you learn here will be invaluable in the future."'' ==Notes== * Despite being a [[primary quest]], completing it is not necessary for receiving [[Unsettling Rumors]] or [[A Second Profession]] from [[Armin Saberlin]] and continuing with the story. Both quests can be obtained as soon as you complete your primary profession test. {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}}
